teaHouse.guidelines.welcome.subtitle.english: A shared learning space where Japanese learners help each other calmly, kindly, and thoughtfully.
teaHouse.guidelines.welcome.subtitle.translated: Uno spazio di apprendimento condiviso dove gli studenti di giapponese si aiutano a vicenda con calma, gentilezza e riflessione.

teaHouse.guidelines.welcome.description.english: The Tea House is a shared learning space where Japanese learners help each other calmly, kindly, and thoughtfully. Everyone — free and premium users alike — is welcome to ask questions and share answers, as long as they support learning Japanese in a respectful way.
teaHouse.guidelines.welcome.description.translated: La Tea House è uno spazio di apprendimento condiviso dove gli studenti di giapponese si aiutano a vicenda con calma, gentilezza e riflessione. Tutti — utenti gratuiti e premium — sono benvenuti a fare domande e condividere risposte, purché supportino l'apprendimento del giapponese in modo rispettoso.

teaHouse.guidelines.whatFor.title.english: What the Tea House is for
teaHouse.guidelines.whatFor.title.translated: A cosa serve la Tea House

teaHouse.guidelines.whatFor.intro.english: The Tea House is the right place for:
teaHouse.guidelines.whatFor.intro.translated: La Tea House è il posto giusto per:

teaHouse.guidelines.whatFor.point1.english: Asking questions about Japanese language (grammar, kanji, vocabulary, usage)
teaHouse.guidelines.whatFor.point1.translated: Fare domande sulla lingua giapponese (grammatica, kanji, vocabolario, uso)

teaHouse.guidelines.whatFor.point2.english: Discussing Japanese culture, traditions, and customs
teaHouse.guidelines.whatFor.point2.translated: Discutere di cultura, tradizioni e usanze giapponesi

teaHouse.guidelines.whatFor.point3.english: Clarifying things from textbooks, videos, stories, or real content
teaHouse.guidelines.whatFor.point3.translated: Chiarire cose da libri di testo, video, storie o contenuti reali

teaHouse.guidelines.whatFor.point4.english: Checking if a sentence sounds natural or correct
teaHouse.guidelines.whatFor.point4.translated: Verificare se una frase suona naturale o corretta

teaHouse.guidelines.whatFor.point5.english: Sharing and discussing learning resources, methods, and experiences
teaHouse.guidelines.whatFor.point5.translated: Condividere e discutere risorse di apprendimento, metodi ed esperienze

teaHouse.guidelines.whatNotFor.title.english: What the Tea House is not for
teaHouse.guidelines.whatNotFor.title.translated: A cosa non serve la Tea House

teaHouse.guidelines.whatNotFor.intro.english: To keep the Tea House calm and useful, please don't post:
teaHouse.guidelines.whatNotFor.intro.translated: Per mantenere la Tea House calma e utile, per favore non pubblicare:

teaHouse.guidelines.whatNotFor.point3.english: Gatekeeping or shaming learners for their level
teaHouse.guidelines.whatNotFor.point3.translated: Escludere o vergognare gli studenti per il loro livello

teaHouse.guidelines.whatNotFor.point4.english: Promotion of other apps, courses, or channels
teaHouse.guidelines.whatNotFor.point4.translated: Promozione di altre app, corsi o canali

teaHouse.guidelines.whatNotFor.point5.translated: Risposte generate da AI pubblicate senza comprensione

teaHouse.guidelines.whatNotFor.point6.english: Medical, legal, or personal advice unrelated to Japanese learning
teaHouse.guidelines.whatNotFor.point6.translated: Consigli medici, legali o personali non correlati all'apprendimento del giapponese

teaHouse.guidelines.whatNotFor.point7.english: Completely off-topic discussions unrelated to Japan or learning Japanese
teaHouse.guidelines.whatNotFor.point7.translated: Discussioni completamente fuori tema non correlate al Giappone o all'apprendimento del giapponese

teaHouse.guidelines.conduct.title.english: How we treat each other here

teaHouse.guidelines.conduct.point2.english: Assume everyone is learning in good faith
teaHouse.guidelines.conduct.point2.translated: Presumi che tutti stiano imparando in buona fede

teaHouse.guidelines.conduct.point3.translated: Spiega in modo semplice e chiaro

teaHouse.guidelines.conduct.point4.english: If it wouldn't help you learn, don't post it
teaHouse.guidelines.conduct.point4.translated: Se non ti aiuterebbe a imparare, non pubblicarlo

teaHouse.guidelines.conduct.noStupidQues.english: There is no such thing as a "stupid question" here.

teaHouse.guidelines.moderation.point1.english: The community can flag posts that don't fit the Tea House
teaHouse.guidelines.moderation.point1.translated: La comunità può segnalare post che non si adattano alla Tea House

teaHouse.guidelines.moderation.point2.english: Moderators may remove posts that break these guidelines
teaHouse.guidelines.moderation.point2.translated: I moderatori possono rimuovere post che violano queste linee guida

teaHouse.guidelines.moderation.point3.english: Repeated violations may limit Tea House access
teaHouse.guidelines.moderation.point3.translated: Violazioni ripetute possono limitare l'accesso alla Tea House

teaHouse.guidelines.moderation.purpose.english: Moderation exists to protect the learning space — not to punish.
teaHouse.guidelines.moderation.purpose.translated: La moderazione esiste per proteggere lo spazio di apprendimento — non per punire.

teaHouse.guidelines.corePrinciple.english: Be kind first, correct second. Assume everyone is learning in good faith.
teaHouse.guidelines.corePrinciple.translated: Sii gentile prima, correggi dopo. Presumi che tutti stiano imparando in buona fede.

teaHouse.guidelines.closing.english: The Tea House works because everyone helps keep it calm, focused, and welcoming. Thank you for being part of it.
teaHouse.guidelines.closing.translated: La Tea House funziona perché tutti aiutano a mantenerla calma, concentrata e accogliente. Grazie per farne parte.

teaHouse.guidelines.pleaseReadAndAgree.english: Please take a moment to read and agree to our community guidelines
teaHouse.guidelines.pleaseReadAndAgree.translated: Per favore, prenditi un momento per leggere e accettare le nostre linee guida della comunità

teaHouse.guidelines.iAgree.english: I understand and agree to the Tea House guidelines
teaHouse.guidelines.iAgree.translated: Capisco e accetto le linee guida della Tea House

teaHouse.guidelines.mustAgree.english: Please agree to the guidelines to continue
teaHouse.guidelines.mustAgree.translated: Per favore accetta le linee guida per continuare

teaHouse.guidelines.acknowledged.english: Thank you! You can now post in the Tea House
teaHouse.guidelines.acknowledged.translated: Grazie! Ora puoi pubblicare nella Tea House

teaHouse.guidelines.acknowledgeFailed.translated: Impossibile salvare il riconoscimento. Per favore riprova.
